items.html:
Aditya Dole is a right-arm medium-pacer who has played a handful of first-class matches for Maharashtra. His first Ranji Trophy game was against Rajasthan in December 2007 but his career highlight came the following year, when he took 10 for 63 in an innings for Maharashtra in a CK Nayudu Trophy match, also against Rajasthan. Ironically, it was Rajasthan Royals who signed him for the 2010 season of the IPL.
Cricinfo Staff (April 2010)
